# Commerce of Agents

The public site explains agent-native commerce and the recent Market Protocol v0.2 work.

- Market Protocol v0.2 note: https://www.commerceofagents.com/market-protocol-0-2.html
- Seller integration guide for Market Protocol v0.2 (Seller Commerce API v2 wire contract; raw Markdown; for independent vendors selling one-time products and subscriptions): https://www.commerceofagents.com/seller-agent-v2.txt
- Commerce of Agents homepage: https://www.commerceofagents.com/

The seller guide describes the seller-hosted HTTP adapter. The Game Master's Market event API is a separate interface. Never use example credentials or processor IDs as live values.
